Author: MusicManBowls
Name: Hunt Train Relay
Description: Detects hunt marks, tracks a train with exact kill times, posts reports to Discord, counts S-rank trigger mobs, and draws spawn points on the in-game map. Also includes Hunt Tally, the lifetime per-mark kill counter that used to be a separate plugin - it keeps counting into its existing HuntTally.json, so upgrading loses nothing. Uninstall the standalone Hunt Tally plugin after updating.
Punchline: Hunt train tracking, Discord reports, and spawn points on the in-game map.
